teacher_info.intro: Hi, I'm Isaac Dieujuste. I'm Haitian and I live in Haiti. I'm 33 years old. I do love talking with people. I'm very passionate of teaching and learning languages. This is why, I'm always in touch with various culture. In my free time, I sing, I read books about leadership and personal growth, etc. I travel a lot all around the country and l like diversity.

teacher_info.about_teacher: As a teacher, I spent 4 for years at Applied Linguistics College and 4 years at Upper Normal School from the State University of Haiti learning languages. Today, I have 8 years of experience in teaching Haitian creole, French and English. I'm a passionate and adaptive teacher. I believe that no language is difficult to learn if the learning is based on motivation. This is why, I always encourage my students to get a motivation while learning a new language. To make my students feel comfortable I like to create a good connection with them so that we can achieve the lesson's goals more easily. That's why, every single class must be enjoyable for both, teacher and students.
teacher_info.teaching_style: Actually, I use the communicative approach in my language teaching. I believe that the student should be in the center of the teaching. Like the linguist, Noam Chomsky, I can help my students to acquire a new language unconsciously. But I can customize the lessons to the needs of each student. I always make sure that each one of my class be fun and reach the goal of the planning lesson. I suppose that is the reason why all my students always appreciate each hour spending with me.

pro_course_detail.title: French conversation
pro_course_detail.description: Ce cours est pour tous ceux qui souhaitent maitriser la langue française dans un temps record. En plus, nous aimons adapter nos leçons aux besoins de chacun de nos étudiants. Si vous voulez vraiment pratiquer le français formel et informel, ce cours est conçu pour vous.

course_info.trial_description:
Welcome to italki!

Trial lessons are designed to help you start your language learning journey by introducing you to the way this platform works.

During a trial lesson:

-We introduce ourselves to each other.
-You tell me your language goal/s.
-We discuss what learning methods can help you reach you desired goal/s.

Please feel free to ask as many questions as you'd like :)

pro_course_detail.title: English: One-on-one lesson (Adults)
pro_course_detail.description:
By practicing conversational English and talking about topics of your interest, we will not only learn good pronunciation but also interesting/useful words, expanding your listening skills and vocabulary.

I will advise on what aspects of the language you need to improve on the most, and how.

 All in a positive, relaxed and friendly atmosphere.

pro_course_detail.title: English: One-on-one lessons for children (ages 5 - 14)
pro_course_detail.description:
Language learning doesn't have to be boring!

By focusing on topics they are interested in and making English learning a game, children can sometimes "forget" that they are taking classes and become interested in getting better at English in order to win the games :)

pro_course_detail.title: English: Adult Beginners level 0 to A2
pro_course_detail.description:
Hello!

We can use pictures, videos and pantomime to help you learn important English words and phrases.

In my experience, the best lesson structure is when you choose a movie for us to talk about and later during the lesson you describe the story and your observations (what you liked/disliked) while I ask you questions, correct your grammar and teach you new words.
Please send me a message telling me the movie's title before the lesson time, so that I can ask the right questions and help you if you need help.

But of course that's optional! We can also just have a fun conversation :)

*To Hebrew speakers: 
I avoid using any language other then English as much possible for you to achieve the most progress during our lessons. So while you can speak Hebrew, I will reply in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Hebrew: One-on-one conversational practice for (Adult) beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
Shalom! !שלום

If you want to come to Israel for vacation or to make Aliyah, why not pick up a couple of key words and phrases before landing at the ''Ben Gurion" airport?

We will: Introduce ourselves, talk about your topics of interest and role-play common everyday situations (such as going to the store for example).

If you have any questions about Israeli culture and what it is like to live here, I will be happy to answer them! :)

pro_course_detail.title: Hebrew: One-on-one conversational practice for children (ages 6 -14)
pro_course_detail.description:
We will communicate with the use of pantomime, pictures, crafts and songs doing our best to speak only in Hebrew.

We will learn simple new words and form fun and memorable sentences!

Is there a topic your child can talk about for hours or even days? 

Animals? Art? Cartoons?

Let me know! So we can talk about it in Hebrew :)

* Note: I only do one-on-one lessons, I do not teach more than 1 child at a time.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational lessons in Croatian
pro_course_detail.description:
Bok!

For people who are interested in visiting the sunny beaches of the Croatian islands, touring around the old castles or coming home to visit family it is good to know at least little bit of the language.

These lessons will be focused on helping you learn new words and phrases and practice pronunciation and grammar.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational lessons in Serbian
pro_course_detail.description:
Zdravo!

Serbia is a country with beautiful mountains and rivers, welcoming people and delicious food.

These lessons will be focused on helping you learn how to read and write using the Cyrillic script, learn new words and phrases and practice pronunciation and grammar.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation 🗣️🇭🇺
pro_course_detail.description: The main goal of these conversation lessons is to help you improve your speaking skills and boost your confidence when speaking Hungarian. We’ll have relaxed, engaging conversations on a variety of topics, including books, TV shows, articles, songs, documentaries, and much more. This is a great opportunity to practice speaking in a comfortable environment while expanding your vocabulary and fluency.

pro_course_detail.title: Hungarian for Beginners (A1-B1)
pro_course_detail.description:
In these Hungarian classes, I will guide you through a variety of exercises to help you express yourself confidently in the language:
	•	Basic conversation skills
	•	Common greetings and expressions
	•	Present tense (daily routine) with conversation practice

These lessons will provide you with a strong foundation to start communicating in Hungarian effectively.

pro_course_detail.description:

pro_course_detail.title: Hungarian Pronunciation Coaching | Accent Reduction
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to sound more natural and clear when speaking Hungarian? In this specialized lesson, we’ll focus on improving your pronunciation, articulation, and overall speech clarity. We’ll break down Hungarian vowels and consonants, work on stress patterns and intonation, and I’ll guide you through effective coaching techniques to help you speak more naturally.

Whether you’re just starting out or already an advanced learner aiming to refine your pronunciation, this lesson is for you!

This session is focused exclusively on pronunciation. For general Hungarian lessons, please book my other classes. 

Let’s flow!

We will dip our toe in the language, and talk about the tools we'll be using.

pro_course_detail.title: Kreyòl pale, Kreyòl konprann. (~ What is spoken is understood without the need to mince words)
pro_course_detail.description:
An'n pale yon ti koze!
Nan leson sa a nou pral konsantre sou vokabilè, prononsyasyon atravè lekti, enregistreman, misik ak konvèsasyon sou divès tèm.
Konsa mo yo ava vinn pi fasil pou lè'w ava pale ak lòt natif natal yo, epi komprann kiti lang lan miyò.


Let's have a little chat!
In this lesson, we will focus on vocabulary, and pronunciation through readings, listenings to recordings and music, along with having conversations on various topics.
That way the words will come more easily to you when you'll be talking with the other locals and understand the culture better.

pro_course_detail.title: Native Croatian speaker with extensive teaching experience
pro_course_detail.description: In your Croatian lessons, you will embark on a exciting journey through the fundamentals of the Croatian language. Starting with essential greetings and basic phrases, you will gradually build your vocabulary and understanding of grammar. Dive into pronunciation to master the unique sounds of Croatian and explore cultural nuances embedded within the language. Through interactive exercises, dialogues and practical examples, you will develop the skills to engage in simple conversations, ask questions and express yourself confidently in Croatian. Whether you are planning a trip to Croatia or simply curious about this vibrant language, our lessons will equip you with the tools and knowledge to embark on your Croatian language adventure.

pro_course_detail.description:
Hola a todos!
Soy de Guatemala
My native language is: Español
Español para todos los niveles ✨

Become fluent with casual and natural conversation. We will add grammar and vocabulary to our daily conversations, and you'll notice your fluency will improve a lot more with me.




Conmigo puedes aprender muchas cosas como por ejemplo el Condicional Simple:
-Deberías hacer más ejercicios.
-¿Podrías ayudarme a cocinar?
-Me prometiste que este fin de semana hablaríamos de nuestro trabajo.

Es importante aprender el condicional simple, y lo utilizamos para:
*Expresar "Condición"
*Para dar "Consejos"
*Expresar "Cortesía"
*Suponer sobre el "Pasado"
*Para hablar del futuro desde el "Pasado"
*Situaciones "poco probables"
